title: Bron Lewis - Chaos
overview: Bron's life is complete, utter chaos. Three kids – an emotional tweenager, a four-year old stalker and the middle one. Just when things couldn't get any harder, she bought a puppy. A million plates in the air, even more smashed on the ground around her feet. Bron wears the battle scars of an ex high-school teacher and is still reeling from the initial shock of motherhood 12 years ago. Tackling juggle-parenting, teaching, career change and flailing mental health, if you've ever thought 'if one thing goes wrong, we're all dead meat' this is the show for you.
